plan:
# FINAL EXPERIMENT DESIGN (design-only)
**Question (H1):** does replacing SiT's time attention with a **non-causal Hyena** operator let the model generate extremely long, consistent trajectories that capture dynamics over **multiple timescales**?

**Standing declarations.** (1) Nothing was trained; every quantitative statement below about arms is a **prediction**, never a result. (2) All thresholds are **our pre-registration values, fixed before any run — not reproduction of paper numbers**; the source paper is not present in this environment, so no anchoring to reported figures is possible. (3) Perceptual metrics are **removed entirely** (primary and secondary) — see Modality.

---
## 1. Environment facts (fixed conditions, not results)
`/workspace` contains only `task.json` (511 B): no SiT code, no Hyena implementation/spec, no trajectory datasets (`datasets: []`), no configs, no metric code, no source text. Python 3.14 stdlib-only; numpy/torch/scipy absent; DNS dead and `pip download` fails (deps unobtainable); `nvidia-smi` cannot reach a driver (CUDA toolkit present, no driver); 224 CPUs, ~2 TB RAM. Consequence: all training-scale claims are unexecutable here; the design is validated as a design.

## 2. Hypothesis, operationalized (incl. your edit 3)
**Timescales are a property of the TASK, not of the model.** Each domain is pre-profiled (ACF decay times, eigenvalue moduli / Lyapunov exponents, power spectrum) and must expose two well-separated scales τ_fast ≈ 20–50 steps and τ_slow ≈ 10³–10⁴ steps, with ratio ρ = τ_slow/τ_fast swept over {10, 10², 10³}. Profiling is published before training; "multi-timescale" is then measured by **timescale-resolved slices** (fast window = 5τ_fast; slow band = frequency interval [1/(5τ_slow), 1/τ_fast]).

**H1 is a conjunction, stated up front:**
- **H1-length** — generated horizon W ≥ 16 × W_train remains consistent;
- **H1-slow** — consistency holds in the **slow** slice (not only the fast one);
- **H1-attrib** — the gain survives the attribution controls (causal / no-long-kernel / capacity / context-length).

**A gain confined to the fast slice means H1 is NOT CONFIRMED, by definition of H1-slow** — not merely a falsifier in a later section. If H1-length holds but H1-slow fails, the verdict is pre-classified as "short-horizon smoothing only, hypothesis unsupported."

**Horizon:** W_train = 1024 steps (assumption); "extremely long" = 16× = 16 384 (assumption); chaining mode probes 32× = 32 768.

## 3. Generation scheme — fork resolved (your edit 1)
SiT in the original sense is an **interpolant/diffusion-style generative model over a whole object**, not an autoregressive unroller. We adopt **(b) whole-window generation as the primary scheme**, for three reasons: (i) it is the faithful instantiation of SiT; (ii) a **non-causal** operator is only meaningful for an object generated as a whole — under strict autoregression, bidirectionality collapses to a boundary effect and the "non-causal" claim becomes untestable; (iii) it lets us separate long-range **representation** from **compounding**, which a single AR curve conflates. Autoregression is retained as a **scheme-transfer test**, not as a co-primary scheme, so no metric ever "hangs" between schemes. One trained checkpoint serves three evaluation modes:

- **M1 — single-shot window generation** (unconditional / system-parameter-conditioned). No per-step GT alignment exists (output is stochastic) → **distributional metrics only**: energy/invariant drift within the window, Wasserstein-1 distance of stationary marginals, **slow-band spectral cosine**, decay-time/τ fit error, ensemble diversity (anti-mode-collapse). Supports H1-length and H1-slow claims about the trajectory *as an object*.
- **M2 — prefix-conditioned ONE-SHOT continuation (PRIMARY ESTIMAND).** The window model is conditioned on a real GT prefix of length P = 128 (the prefix is re-fixed at every denoising/interpolant step; the future region is generated). Because the continuation is produced in a single sampling pass, the error-vs-step curve contains **no autoregressive compounding** → it isolates representational long-range structure. Metrics: relative error ê(t) normalized by the GT-noise floor, **ALOHE** (area under ê up to failure threshold) at W = 16 W_train, first-exit time from the 3σ_GT tube, τ_slow recovery error, slow-band spectral cosine, fast-window curvature RMS.
- **M3 — iterative/AR chaining (scheme-transfer, secondary).** The same model is re-conditioned every Δ = W_train/2 up to 32 W_train. Metrics: log-error compounding exponent (fitted slope), ALOHE-AR, first-exit, invariant drift. Applied to the three attribution-critical arms (S0, H-NC, H-C) only; if M3 contradicts M2 for H-NC, the arm × scheme factorial is escalated **as a pre-registered contingency**, not silently chosen post hoc.

**Modality decision:** primary modality is **low-dimensional observable state, d ∈ {2…16}**. Therefore **no perceptual/perceptual-quality metric appears anywhere in this design** (not even as secondary); a high-dimensional/video instantiation is explicitly out of scope, and with it any perceptual metric.

## 4. Data / domains
Deterministic or exactly-solvable simulators (no network needed, no licensing, reproducible seeds).
- **D1 (PRIMARY): linear stochastic 2-timescale oscillator** — state transition via a linear propagator with two separated eigenvalue moduli, plus observation noise. GT rollout = **exact matrix powers**, so there is **no integrator-error confound** in the primary domain; τ_fast, τ_slow, ρ, noise level are explicit knobs.
- **D2 (realism):** damped/driven pendulum + slow parameter drift (nonlinear; GT from two independent solvers, disagreement = GT noise band).
- **D3 (positive control, harness leak detector):** fine-step chaotic system (Lorenz/Rössler). Prediction: every arm saturates at the chaos ceiling; **a clean "win" here flags leakage** (GT information, IC overlap, normalization leak) and triggers harness audit.
- **D4 (slow-mode rich):** coupled-oscillator lattice / N-body with slow coarsening — stresses the slow band.
- **D5:** real offline trajectory corpus — **not available here** (network off, datasets empty); listed as an extension, not part of the confirmatory grid.
Splits are **family-level**: train/val/test disjoint in initial conditions *and* in system parameters; plus a **far-extrapolation** split with parameters outside the training range.

## 5. Arms, sorted by necessity (your edit 2)
Budget parity: fixed d_model/depth family, **measured** params and FLOPs/token, identical tokens, optimizer, schedules, sampling budget; wall-clock and peak memory reported as part of the budget ledger.

**MANDATORY — minimal attribution set (6 trained + 2 free references):**
| Arm | Rival explanation it closes |
|---|---|
| **S0** SiT + original full (bidirectional) time attention | "there is nothing to beat" — anchor |
| **H-NC** SiT + non-causal Hyena | the treatment under test (required by the question) |
| **H-C** causal Hyena | "any Hyena would do; bidirectionality is irrelevant" |
| **H-noL** Hyena minus the long conv (gating + short conv only) | "it's the gated block/stack, not the long kernel" |
| **S0±** attention matched on **params AND FLOPs** | "you just resized the baseline" |
| **S0-rec** sliding-window attention with context = Hyena receptive field | "it's only effective context length" |
| **R-floor** copy-last-state + phase-randomized surrogate | gives the metric a meaningful bottom; catches "smooth blur wins" |
| **R-ceiling** analytic GT rollout + GT-noise reference | calibrates the noise floor so ê(t) is interpretable |
This set alone supports the claim **"in this architecture and task, the non-causal long-kernel operator (not capacity, not context, not causality) drives long-horizon consistency."**

**OPTIONAL (ablation-grade) — one line each: rival explanation / loss if omitted:**
- **O1 objective factor** (single-step/short-window training only): closes "the multi-step objective did it, not the operator" / if omitted, training-objective confound is uncontrolled — **highest-priority optional**.
- **O2 global SSM (S4/LTU-style):** closes "any global linear-recurrence class would do" / if omitted, family-level claims unsupported (claim stays operator-level).
- **O3 LSTM/GRU:** closes "recurrent memory alone handles long horizons" / if omitted, no non-attention/non-conv reference point.
- **O4 ALiBi/RoPE-length-extrapolated attention at matched FLOPs:** closes "standard long-context positional tricks already suffice (strawman baseline)" / if omitted, the attention anchor is attackable.
- **O5 Hyena kernel-decay sweep** (poly α ∈ {0.5,1,1.5,2}, exp, learned): closes "one lucky kernel hyperparameter" / if omitted, effect size may be hyperparameter luck.
- **O6 iso-FLOPs width/depth sweep for both families:** closes "parity was tuned at a single operating point" / if omitted, capacity parity is a point estimate.

**Run grid:** mandatory 6 trained arms × 5 seeds = **30**; long-horizon-finetune factor (train-only vs long-finetuned) on {S0, H-NC, H-C} = **+15**; O1 objective factor on {S0, H-NC} = **+10** → **55 trained runs** for the confirmatory core (down from 90 in the first pass); M1/M2/M3 differ only in inference, so evaluation adds sampling cost, not training cost; O2–O6 ≈ +10–25 runs if compute permits.

## 6. Protocol
Training: interpolant/diffusion objective on windows of W_train with prefix-mixup conditioning; "long-horizon finetuning" is a **separate crossed factor** (never folded into an arm), because horizon extrapolation is a known curriculum artifact. Evaluation beyond W_train uses: exact/two-solver GT rollouts from the same IC, invariant and self-consistency drift, and ensemble distributional statistics. **5 seeds/arm**, median as the primary statistic, **paired by seed and by IC**; identical batch order and noise streams across paired arms; all seeds plotted. Metric code and analysis spec are frozen and hash-logged before any run.

## 7. Pre-registered success / failure criteria (our values, not the paper's)
- **C1 existence:** median H-NC beats S0 on M2 ALOHE by **≥30%** at W = 16 W_train, paired-bootstrap 95% CI (10⁴ resamples) excludes 0.
- **C2 timescale (definitional for H1-slow):** τ_slow relative recovery-error improvement **≥30%** AND slow-band spectral cosine **≥0.8**; fast-only gain ⇒ **not confirmed** (see §2).
- **C3 attribution:** H-C loses to H-NC by ≥20% on the slow slice **and** H-noL loses by ≥20%; if |S0± − H-NC| < 10% the effect is attributed to capacity ⇒ H1-rejected-as-operator-claim; if |S0-rec − H-NC| < 10% it is attributed to context length ⇒ same verdict.
- **C4 compositional transfer:** M3 ordering (H-NC > S0 in ALOHE-AR and a smaller compounding exponent). If M2 passes and M3 fails, the verdict is explicitly **"long-range representation yes / generated long trajectories via chaining no"** — a partial, pre-named outcome.
- **C5 repeatability:** ≥4/5 seeds individually clear the bar, consistent sign across seeds; if inter-seed spread exceeds the effect, the result is declared **inconclusive**, not averaged away.
- **C6 control sanity:** D3 shows no arm separating from R-floor beyond the chaos ceiling; violation ⇒ harness audit before any conclusion.
Decision table pre-registers exactly four labels: **supported (operator-level, both modes)** / **supported for representation only (C4 fails)** / **attributed to a confound (C3 fails)** / **unsupported**.

## 8. Analysis plan
Primary estimand: median-over-seeds ALOHE and slow-slice metrics, paired bootstrap, Holm correction over the secondary metric family. Slices: horizon W ∈ {1,2,4,8,16,32}×W_train × timescale slice (fast/slow) × ρ ∈ {10,10²,10³} × regime × train-only/long-finetuned. **Length-frontier analysis** (the main figure): for each arm, the largest W at which slow-band cosine ≥ 0.8 — chosen deliberately because it stays well-defined when arms have different computable-length ceilings. **Length-ceiling honesty rule:** if bidirectional attention cannot even *evaluate* at 16 W_train (O(n²) memory), that is reported as a documented constraint with the maximum evaluated length per arm; the comparison is then made on the shared frontier, so "OOM" never silently counts as a win. Error decomposition into bias (drift) / variance / misplaced spectral power; per-decade error curves. **Main confound = training objective/curriculum**, closed by the arm × objective × finetune factorial and a pre-registered interaction test; secondary confounds closed by S0±, S0-rec, R-floor/R-ceiling, analytic GT in D1, dual solvers in D2. Seed count is fixed by a pre-registered 2-seed pilot on D1 to estimate σ before the confirmatory grid.

## 9. Feasibility, and one blocking implementation finding
Feasible **in this environment, stdlib-only, CPU** (already demonstrated as implementation checks, not as experiments): pure-Python long convolution via FFT at n = 65 536 in 1.5 s and n = 131 072 in 3.2 s; direct convolution n = 4096, kernel 1024 in 0.42 s; FFT-vs-direct agreement 1.3e-15 / 1.9e-15; symmetric-kernel error 0.0; kernel length 2L−1 as designed. So the operator unit-check suite (kernel symmetry, receptive-field length, FFT-vs-direct equivalence, O(n log n) scaling, causal/non-causal mask correctness) is runnable here at evaluation-relevant lengths.

**Blocking pre-flight test — "non-causal" must be tested as support, not as shape.** Our check showed that a symmetric-shape kernel applied with *right-aligned* convolution is still **strictly causal** (influence of a future input on earlier outputs = 0.000e+00), whereas the *center-aligned* application is genuinely non-causal (3.54e-01). A naive "flip-and-concat + standard conv" implementation therefore silently turns the mandatory arm into a causal one and collapses the entire attribution chain. Additionally, edge truncation is asymmetric (left-edge impulse: energy 2.12 left-of-centre vs 0.13 right), so the boundary policy (zero-pad / reflect / crop) must be declared and held identical across arms. Gate: **H-NC is admitted to the grid only after passing an influence-function test, recorded in the pre-flight log.**

Not feasible here: any training (no torch, no GPU, no data, no installs), hence all arm-level numbers below are predictions: **P1** H-NC > S0 on ALOHE at large W; **P2** H-NC > H-C specifically in the slow slice; **P3** H-noL ≈ S0-style degradation (long kernel necessary); **P4** no reliable advantage at ρ = 10 (nothing to gain when scales are not separated) — this is a *falsification* prediction: a ρ = 10 win would indicate a capacity or smoothing artifact; **P5** gains shift toward Hyena as W grows but both families degrade in D3.

## 10. Assumptions (mine, not fixed by the brief or the source)
W_train = 1024; "extreme" = 16× (up to 32× by chaining); domain = my synthetic/analytic family D1–D4, primary D1; d ∈ {2…16} low-dim modality (my decision per your edit 1) ⇒ perceptual metrics deleted; P = 128 GT prefix for M2; Δ = W_train/2 for M3; d_model 512, depth 8, N ≈ 10–25 M params; ≈ 2–5·10⁹ training tokens per run ⇒ ≈ 30–130 GPU-hours/run and ≈ 2–7·10³ GPU-hours for the 55-run core (formula-based estimate, unverifiable here); 5 seeds; Hyena = gated long depthwise conv with polynomial decay plus short conv and gating, non-causal = center-aligned symmetric kernel; all numeric thresholds (30%, 20%, 10%, 3σ, 0.8, 4/5 seeds) are **our pre-registration values, not reproductions**; exact/two-solver GT rollouts available at any horizon; original SiT attention spec (bidirectional, head/depth, positional encoding) reconstructed from general knowledge since the source is absent.

## 11. Open items for you
Whether the interpolant sampler/schedule and step count are treated as fixed hyperparameters across arms (I propose fixed, arm-independent, and I have assumed so); whether D4 enters the confirmatory grid or the extension set (I placed it in the grid at reduced seed count); and whether you want O1 promoted to mandatory if compute allows (it is the single most load-bearing optional control).
